title: eBay continues to bet on live shopping after record quarter | TechCrunch
summary: It plans to expand eBay Live to more international markets in the coming weeks and months. “These results reinforce our confidence that Live can deepen engagement, broaden discovery, and increase velocity across the broader eBay marketplace,” CEO Jamie Iannone told investors.
